name: Czechoslovakia

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands of white over red, with a blue isosceles triangle at the hoist reaching to the centre; it is identical to the flag of Czechia today.
flag.symbolism: White and red are the colours of Bohemia; the blue triangle was added to set the flag apart from Poland's and is often said to stand for Slovakia and Moravia.

hook: Czechoslovakia's flag is exactly the flag Czechia flies today: white over red with a blue triangle from the hoist, which the Philippines echoes in blue and red with a white triangle.
trivia: When the country split on 1 January 1993, the dissolution law barred both successors from using federal symbols, but the Czech Republic kept the flag anyway.
During the German occupation of 1939–1945 the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia used a horizontal white-red-blue tricolour instead.
